firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Click the extension icon to open the sidebar panel
Swap an Ant Design component in src/sidebar/ to see it update
useCases: A sidebar built from Ant Design components
A component library bundled into an extension surface
Starting point for extensions with a ready-made design system

store.summary: Adds a sidebar panel built with Ant Design.

justifications.sidePanel: Renders the extension's main interface in the browser side panel.
justifications.Content script match <all_urls>: The content script runs on the pages the user visits to render the extension's on-page interface. Narrow this to the specific sites your extension needs before submitting.

versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the sidebar-antd template. Not yet submitted to any store.
